name: 20 Microns Limited
company_profile: 20 Microns Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in business of manufacturing and selling of industrial micronized minerals and specialty chemicals. The Company manufactures and supplies a wide range of micronized minerals, white minerals, and specialty chemicals to both local and international markets. Its product portfolio includes industrial minerals, and specialty chemical. Its industrial minerals include ball clay, barytes, bentonite, bleaching earth, calcined kaolin, calcium carbonate, diatomaceous earth, dolomite, feldspar, fullers earth, kaolin, mica, perlite, ramming mass, silica, talc, wollastonite, and others. Its specialty chemical includes activators-magnesium oxide, activators-zinc oxide, desiccants, flame retardants & smoke suppressant, fumed silica, mullite, organo clays-rheological additive, performance mineral additive, precipitated silica, rheology modifier, semi reinforcing eco green filler, synthetic barytes, synthetic barytes, and others.

name: 21st Century Management Services Limited
company_profile: Twentyfirst Century Management Services Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in investments in capital and debt instruments. It operates through the Capital Market operations segment. The Company has a wholly owned subsidiary, Twentyfirst Century Shares & Securities Limited, which is also engaged in investment activities like the capital market and futures and options segment.

name: 360 ONE WAM LIMITED
company_profile: 360 ONE WAM Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the distribution of various financial products and advising clients on wealth management through mutual funds and alternative investment fund platforms. Its segments include Wealth Management and Asset Management. The Wealth Management segment comprises distribution of financial products, advisory, equity and debt broking, estate planning and managing financial products, essentially in the nature of advisory. It also includes lending and investment activities which are complimentary to wealth management activities. The Asset Management segment comprises management of pooled funds under various products and structures, such as mutual funds, alternative asset funds, portfolio management and related activities. It caters to high networth individuals (HNIs) and ultra-high networth individuals (UHNIs), family offices, and institutional clients through a range of tailored wealth management solutions.

name: 3B Blackbio Dx Limited
company_profile: 3B Blackbio DX Limited is an India-based company, which is engaged in the field of polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based Molecular Diagnostic Kits. Its segments include Agrochemicals and Diagnostic kits. The diagnostics division of the Company is engaged in Design, Development Manufacturing and Commercialization of qPCR tests, Rapid tests, Next Gen Sequencing (NGS)-based Molecular Diagnostic Kits and Extraction Kits for reliable testing on patient samples. Its products include Oncology and Hematology, Antimicrobial Resistance, Infectious Diseases, Human Genetics, Extraction, and Rapid Antigen Kits. The PCR-based Molecular Diagnostic Kits are commercialized with TRUPCR brand to renowned diagnostics labs across the country. The Company also has a Lateral Flow Assays Vertical and a NGS Assay development division. The lateral flow assays are commercialized under the brand name TRURAPID and the NGS assays are commercialized under the brand name TRUNGS.

name: 3i Infotech Limited
company_profile: 3i Infotech Limited is an India-based global information technology company. Its segments include Application, Automation, Analytics (AAA); Infrastructure Services (IS); Business Process Services (BPS), and Others. Its AAA segment unit is digital service delivery, offering integrated solutions for application development and maintenance, process automation, and data-driven insights. Its IS segment provides services across end-user computing, data centers, cloud, and network management. Its BPS segment digitizes and re-engineers core operations across sectors. The Company offers analytics-driven, omni-channel solutions for areas like claims management, fund accounting, and digital collections. Its Others segment includes the Company’s digital media operations. Its products and services include Digital Infrastructure Management Services, Cloud, NuRe Edge, Cybersecurity, Application, Oracle Solutions, NuRe Campus, EnGRC, Data Warehouse, Digital BPS, Wi-Fi Monetization and others.

name: 3M India Limited
company_profile: 3M India Limited is an India-based company, which manages its operations through four segments: Safety & Industrial; Transportation & Electronics; Health Care; and Consumer. The Safety & Industrial segment's products include vinyl, polyester, functional and decorative graphics, abrasion-resistant films, masking tapes and other specialty materials. The Health care segment's products include medical and surgical supplies, medical devices, and skin and wound care. The Transportation & Electronics segment's products include personal protection products, brand and asset protection solutions and border control products. This segment also includes the graphics business. The Consumer segment includes products, such as Scotch brand, addressing the home and office tapes, adhesives, and packaging protection platforms, among others. Its brands include Command, Littmann, Nexcare, Post-it, Scotch-Brite and Scotch. The Company has manufacturing facilities in India at Ahmedabad, Bengaluru and Pune.

name: 3P Land Holdings Limited
company_profile: 3P Land Holdings Limited is an India-based company that is engaged in the business of lending, investment activity and real estate leasing. The Company's segments include Leasing and Investment. The Company has about 16 acres of land in the village of kareli near Narsinghpur.

name: 5Paisa Capital Limited
company_profile: 5paisa Capital Limited is an India-based technology-driven financial service company. The Company's business is to provide broking services to its clients in the capital markets. It provides financial products through online platforms and mobile applications. Its customer base mainly comprises retail investors, traders who deal in the securities market and seek do-it-yourself services. Its product includes broking, mutual funds, wealth management, research products, insurance, algorithmic trading, learning platform (Finschool), and community (Stocky5). Through its Internet terminals and mobile applications, it provides its clients with access to its online technology platform for trading in securities and commodities on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), and Multi Commodity Exchange of India Limited (MCX). Its subsidiaries are 5paisa P2P Limited, 5paisa Trading Limited, 5paisa Corporate Services Limited, and 5paisa International Securities (IFSC) Limited.

name: 63 moons technologies limited
company_profile: 63 Moons Technologies Limited is an India-based company, which is primarily engaged in computer programming, consultancy, and related services. The Company’s segments include Software services/Solutions and Others. The Software services /Solutions segment is engaged in processing solutions and includes an integrated mix of various products, projects, and activities incidental thereto. The Others segment includes trading, procurement, process management, risk consultancy activities, shared business support services, information technology (IT) infrastructure sharing, non-banking financial company (NBFC) related activities, and Internet telecommunication services. The Company offers technology intellectual property (IP) and domain expertise to trade on financial markets across all asset classes, including equities, commodities, currencies, and bonds. Its cybersecurity solutions include CYBX, Zimperium MTD, Morphisec Keep, Morphisec Guard, and 63 SATS.

name: A2Z Infra Engineering Limited
company_profile: A2Z Infra Engineering Limited provides maintenance and engineering services. Its segments include Engineering Services (ES), Facility Management Services (FMS), Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) and Others. The ES strategic business units of the Company undertake engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects for the telecom and the power transmission and distribution (T&D) sub-sectors of the infrastructure. Under the Power T&D infrastructure sub-sector projects, it offers various sets of services, including testing, integrated design, construction, installation and erection, which is concluded with project commissioning. The key services under its FMS segment include technical services, business support, and consulting. Under MSW, it works with the local civic bodies or local governments in observing and maintaining cities or towns clean and sanitized, in north India. Its comprehensive MSW services include collection, transportation, treatment, and disposal of solid waste.
